caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The object is a circular, wide band resembling a collar or a bracelet, rendered in shades of brown and yellow ochre, with variations in tone providing a marbled or mottled appearance. The band features a flap overlapping at the front, with two small round metal fasteners and two vertical slits or holes visible adjacent to the flap. There is no visible texture beyond the color variations. At the lower right corner of the drawing appears a signature written in brownish-red ink, reading "F. Tumagalli" with a straight underline. The overall composition is minimal, with the single object isolated in the center and ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Bracelet
